# pve-rclone-backup queue

Show and control the upload queue.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`cancel`](#queue-cancel) | Cancel a job |
| [`list`](#queue-list) | List jobs |
| [`priority`](#queue-priority) | Change a job's priority (-100..100, higher first) |
| [`retry`](#queue-retry) | Queue a failed, cancelled or skipped job again |
| [`scan`](#queue-scan) | Look for new archives now |
| [`show`](#queue-show) | Show a job and its history |

## queue cancel

Cancel a job.

```
pve-rclone-backup queue cancel <job>
```

## queue list

List jobs.

```
pve-rclone-backup queue list [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--state strings` | only jobs in these states (comma separated) |
| `--storage string` | only jobs of this storage |

## queue priority

Change a job's priority (-100..100, higher first).

```
pve-rclone-backup queue priority <job> <priority>
```

## queue retry

Queue a failed, cancelled or skipped job again.

```
pve-rclone-backup queue retry <job>
```

## queue scan

Look for new archives now.

```
pve-rclone-backup queue scan [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--storage string` | only this source or offsite storage |

## queue show

Show a job and its history.

```
pve-rclone-backup queue show <job>
```

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
